maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumable snacks and shakes (Atkins, Quest, OWYN) used up by consumers; not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying Quest, Atkins and OWYN products via grocery, club, mass and e-commerce retailers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through brand sales and new products; Atkins, Quest and OWYN were a few large deals, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers and retailers can easily switch to competing snack bars, chips and shakes; commodity-like consumer packaged foods.
